text.text: I curse my inability for magic.  My peers can conjure up sparks with only two of them combined.  If I try and help them, they don't even get any less exhausted.  Yet I wake up with a medic's worried face over myself.  But I will prove my theories.  The Æther may favour them, but my brain will get me ahead of them.

I did it!
I can finally prove it.  Æthereum is like an ocean, and it courses through our world, our star system, or even the whole galaxy like a river.  And where a basin starts collecting, magical phenomena will occur.  A friend of mine working for the Alchemical Institue has already confirmed that at least one basin I calculated coincided with naturally occuring plants usable for potions.  At least in theory.  She couldn't test it yet, but measuring them revealed faint notes of Æther within them.

I was wondering, why Æthereum pooled around us.  When I thought it pooled around earth I was sure, that gravity affected it.  But with help from 10 colleagues I managed to make a magical observatory reality.  It lasted for nearly a minute and was definitely enough to confirm it:
Æthereum does not pool around earth, or any of our neighbouring planets.  Rather, it flows like a net over and through our star system.  Maybe another hint for why there is life on earth?  Probably not. While it is true that Jupiter has not one stream of Æthereum flowing over it, a mighty stream flows directly through the moon.
Does that mean Æthereum stretches across the entire universe?  Does it expand with it?  Is it maybe even the driving force behind its expansion?  The more I learn, the less I know.  Infuriating!

I know now.
I know now!
I know now!
There must be something behind the Æthereum.  Behind the Veil.  I can't prove it, obviously.  But every single calculation I previously had an unknown variable to account for, with this I can suddenly be so much more accurate.  It's something like antimatter.  A theoretical opposing force to explain the phenomena behind Æthereum.
I decided to call it Nethereum.

It wasn't as simple as I hoped it would be.
Nethereum is not a constant.  It's changing.  And very notably so.  I devised a couple simply formula.  Barely a page long.  With it I can calculate Æther density on the go.  And even if I'm just near apprentices reading a scroll to understand the diagrams, it's already off.  If it's truly the opposing force of Æthereum it shouldn't be that unstable.  Even though it's still predictable.

I'm starting to regret getting into Thaumateurgy.  Every interview they just want to laugh at my expense.  Every couple of years I need to get to know new colleagues because the old ones are "getting to old for this".  And whenever anyone asks about my research I need to re-explain my proven thesis from almost 10 years ago!  If my current thesis proves right, it won't be that much longer before Nethereum and Æthereum share the same four dimensional coordinates.
I have long guessed that neither can be tracked with only our naturally perceivable dimensions.  And I fear I am still lacking something beyond my comprehension.
But this should still be a huge event!

I was wrong again.  A whole day earlier than I predicted.  Æthereum and Nethereum have interacted somehow.  It has become noticably easier to cast magic.  Even I can cast some of the spells I learned in an effort to find one even I can cast.  It worries me, though, that even at 5 in the morning I had several missed calls from ex-colleagues who now work for the goverment.
One of them even sent me an official invite from Homeland Security.  I don't know whether I should feel flattered or threatened.

They absolutely wrecked my labratory!  Asking me what I did to their XEDRA-project or whatever.  Something about teleportation?  Did they actually figure it out?  I know they invited me a long time ago.  But it seemed so unfeasable.  Even if you had all the Æthereum ever, you would still need a kind of medium to transmit coordinates.  And Æthereum can't transmit data.  It has its own will.  You can shape it in front of you, or a bit further away; but you simply can't do both at the same time.  It's impossible!

I figured it out!  The second the last agent left me in what used to be my life's work I figured it out. If Æthereum cannot transmit, then its opposing force Nethereum has to!  And since they recently had a horizon event, you can now use Nethereum to transmit Æthereum from here to there - and you along with it!  But why did they have to bring the whole military to my lab?!
